purpose: Seal independently verified evidence for the current model-origin self-building backbone before attaching new unproven surfaces.
proof_rules: Each parent receipt must match its sealed SHA-256.
Each parent must pass its independent verifier in a separate read-only process.
Model-origin frames, CPU validation, scaffold transitions, and Rust decisions remain separate evidence.
A generation failure must be detected from actual execution and followed by verified isolated rollback.
Production approval absence is a required hold boundary, not an error to repair.
Current Seed 0, registry, pointer, Rust integrity, workers, authority, and protected state must remain unchanged.
